mechanism.name: Time-varying instrumental variables with confounding and censored survival

generation_equations.label: Causal failure time
generation_equations.expression: T00=int_0^T exp(psi*a(s))ds with a(s)=A0 for s<=1 and A1 for s>1; psi=-1 or0. Let q0=exp(psi*A0),q1=exp(psi*A1). T=T00/q0 if T00<=q0; T=1+(T00-q0)/q1 otherwise.

generation_equations.label: Observed representation
generation_equations.expression: R1=I(Y>=1); output second-visit L1,Z1,A1 multiplied by R1, together with R1. Never output T00,U0,U1,T,C or errors.

generation_equations.label: Population target
generation_equations.expression: For fixed treatment regime a, lambda_Ta(t)=exp(psi*a(t)); psi=log(hazard under a(t)=1 / hazard under a(t)=0), at a common time away from1. Baseline hazard=1.

sampling.unit: individual longitudinal trajectory represented as a wide row
sampling.dependence: iid persons; within-person observations at0 and1 depend through latent T00,U and treatment-confounder feedback

assumptions: iid individuals; consistency and no interference; potential treatments constant on (0,1] and after1.
Time-varying Z generated conditional on observed pre-treatment history using independent Bernoulli draws; sequential instrument independence and exclusion given that history.

Instrument positivity and relevance: at visit j, the treatment-probability contrast for Z=1 versus0 equals Delta_j=Phi(0.2 L_j)>0 and is independent of unobserved U_j given L_j (independent compliance type, source Assumption6).
Unmeasured time-varying confounding is present; ordinary sequential ignorability given L alone is not asserted.
Independent censoring C=min(Uniform(0,4),2); estimation target is observed only up to administrative time2.
Second-visit covariates/instrument/treatment only observed while at risk R1=1; use mask and survival endpoint jointly.

properties.notes: L0,L1 are active observed covariate values at two visits, not two independent baseline variables. Phi links, Z_j*Delta_j treatment interactions and piecewise exponential time transformation are nonlinear. A0 affects L1 and U1, yielding treatment-confounder feedback. Second-visit values require R1=1.

estimand.name: psi
estimand.definition: Population marginal structural Cox log hazard ratio for the current binary treatment under fixed two-visit intervention regimes: lambda_Ta(t)=lambda0(t)*exp(psi*a(t)), lambda0(t)=1. Compare treatment1 versus0 at the same time t away from the visit1 switch. Target is psi=-1 or0, not a survival probability difference or LATE.

truth.expression: Population marginal structural Cox log hazard ratio for the current binary treatment under fixed two-visit intervention regimes: lambda_Ta(t)=lambda0(t)*exp(psi*a(t)), lambda0(t)=1. Compare treatment1 versus0 at the same time t away from the visit1 switch. Target is psi=-1 or0, not a survival probability difference or LATE.
truth.derivation: Analytic marginal structural Cox parameter; independent survival-transformation quadrature, root inversion and numerical hazard-ratio checks.

adaptations: Represent one person as a finite numeric wide-table row, retaining visit0 and masking visit1 after failure/censoring before time1 using observed R1 and zero fill. R1 must be used to distinguish unavailable visits from true zeros.
Implement the unnumbered accelerated-failure-time integral with its exact piecewise inverse; original psi=-1 and psi=0 settings retained.
Use seeded NumPy draws rather than claiming the unrecovered author RNG stream; sample size is a hook parameter rather than original 2000,4000,8000.
Independently implement the fully specified main-text mechanism; no author program or supplementary sensitivity scenarios are reproduced.
